description: Unit test module for Salary Structure functionality in ERPNext payroll module, including setup, holiday list creation, salary structure creation, and assignment tests.

classes.name: TestSalaryStructure
classes.description: Unit test class for salary structure features, including setup, holiday list creation, deduction calculations, total calculations, whitespace handling, salary structure assignment, and multi-currency support.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by clearing relevant tables, creating holiday list, and test employees.

methods.name: make_holiday_list
methods.description: Creates a holiday list for testing if it does not already exist.

methods.name: test_salary_structure_deduction_based_on_gross_pay
methods.description: Tests deduction calculation based on gross pay formula.

methods.name: test_amount_totals
methods.description: Verifies total earnings, deductions, gross pay, and net pay calculations.

methods.name: test_whitespaces_in_formula_conditions_fields
methods.description: Ensures formulas and conditions do not contain extraneous whitespace or newlines.

methods.name: test_salary_structures_assignment
methods.description: Tests assigning a salary structure to an employee and verifies assignment details.

methods.name: test_multi_currency_salary_structure
methods.description: Checks creation of a salary structure with a different currency.

methods.name: make_salary_structure
methods.description: Creates and optionally submits a salary structure with specified parameters.

methods.name: create_salary_structure_assignment
methods.description: Creates and submits a salary structure assignment for an employee.

methods.name: get_payable_account
methods.description: Retrieves the default payroll payable account for a given company.
